verdict.rationale: Hightouch documents per-sync run outcome reporting, a sync debugger for inspecting runs and rejected rows, and configurable sync alerts on failed runs. Since each sync maps to one destination, failures can be diagnosed per destination, and a company comparison also cites a live debugger and alerting. Missing for 10: a documented live event-stream view for Hightouch Events, explicit delivery-metrics dashboards (volumes, latency, success rates), and independent hands-on corroboration.
